versions.content: Usage of variable data length in case of S/R com- munication, NvRam access or ECU signal access In case DcmDspDataUse- Port is set to { USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER , USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER_- AS_SERVICE , USE_BLOCK_ID , USE_ECU_SIGNAL }, the usage of variable data length shall be not allowed.
